title: Te Karere o te Waipuke Nui
intro: I tū tēnei tangata hei pou mō te manawanui mō ngā rautau, e karanga ana i tētahi hapori whakakeke ki te māramatanga o te pono, i a ia e tūtaki ana ki ngā tawai me ngā whakahē. Ahakoa ngā āhuatanga uaua me te taumaha o te karere e horapa ana i ngā whakatipuranga, i mau tonu tēnei pononga ki tā rātou misioni tae noa ki te putanga mai o te ture whakamutunga.
clues: E iwa rau e rima tekau tau aku i pau ai ki te karanga i tōku iwi ki te ara o te tika, i te ao, i te pō, i te mea ngaro, i te aroaro o te marea hoki.
I whakatūpato ahau i taku iwi mō te whiu mamae, heoi i kuhua e rātou ō rātou maihao ki roto i ō rātou taringa, ā, i hipokina rātou e te whakapehapeha ki ō rātou kākahu.
I whakahaua ahau kia hanga tetahi mea nui rawa i raro i te titiro a toku Ariki, ahakoa kāore he wai i kitea.
I ahau e mahi ana, ka haere mai ngā rangatira o tōku iwi, ka tawai mai ki ahau, engari i mea atu ahau ki a rātou, ā, e kore e roa ka tawai mai mātou ki a rātou.
I inoi ahau kia hono mai ōku kikokiko me ōku toto ki ahau, engari i whiriwhiria e rātou te rapu piringa ki runga i te maunga, me te whakapono ka whakaora i a rātou i te tai e piki ana.
I tau tōku waka ki runga i Maunga Hūti i muri i te horomia e te whenua te wai, ā, i mutu te ua o te rangi.

arabic: وَقِيلَ يَـٰٓأَرْضُ ٱبْلَعِى مَآءَكِ وَيَـٰسَمَآءُ أَقْلِعِى وَغِيضَ ٱلْمَآءُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَٱسْتَوَتْ عَلَى ٱلْجُودِىِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and it [i.e., the ship] came to rest on the [mountain of] Jūdiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people." (11:44)
